genericProblem: A closed package-specific control may leave its authorized successor unable to establish a truthful package baseline, while a broad implementation assertion can hide finite authorization and interaction exceptions.

counterexamples.claim: P0 package binding can be reused by an RM1 successor.
counterexamples.evidence: The active P0-only branch hard-codes RM1-U01, its historical prompt recovery, and P0's referenced-gate set; a successor would either fail admission or falsely reuse P0 evidence.

counterexamples.claim: Every mutating operation has an authenticated workspace session.
counterexamples.evidence: Eight public invitation/password-reset writes have security: [] and are token-bound owner protocols.

counterexamples.claim: P3-A can implement a new platform OTP UI because its issue table names OTP.
counterexamples.evidence: P6 and RM1-IA-01 explicitly reserve platform OTP login interaction and protocol materialization for Dexter-accepted UI amendment.

findings.summary: Compliance-control has an RM1-U01-only successor activation gap.
P3-A's three broad manifest surfaces omit its approved generator, generated output, typed Problem, platform-IAM, owner-recheck and focused-test implementation paths.
Dexter assigned new platform mobile OTP protocol and UI to P6/RM1-IA-01; P3-A retains only existing server response hardening.
Dexter selected a finite PUBLIC_PROTOCOL requirement mode for the eight token-bound public writes.
